info.name: CV Management - Company & Internship Acceptance
info.description: Patch 9 release acceptance collection. Runs against a real backend and real PostgreSQL data. Requires local ADMIN/STUDENT credentials and two ACTIVE taxonomy Skill UUIDs. It creates uniquely named data and cleans it up at the end.

exec: pm.test('Authenticated principal is STUDENT and not ADMIN', () => {
pm.test('activeSkillId is configured as a UUID', () => pm.expect(skill1, 'Set activeSkillId in the local Postman environment').to.match(uuid));
pm.test('secondActiveSkillId is configured as a UUID', () => pm.expect(skill2, 'Set secondActiveSkillId in the local Postman environment').to.match(uuid));
pm.test('Two distinct active taxonomy skills are configured', () => pm.expect(skill2).to.not.eql(skill1));
pm.test('Strong quoted ETag is returned', () => pm.expect(etag).to.match(/^"\d+"$/));
pm.test('Search returns created Company', () => pm.expect(body.items.some(x => x.companyId === pm.collectionVariables.get('companyId'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('Company update persisted fields', () => { pm.expect(body.contactPerson).to.eql('Acceptance Contact'); pm.expect(body.notes).to.eql('Patch 9 acceptance'); });
pm.test('Removed Company active field is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Strong quoted ETag is returned', () => pm.expect(etag).to.match(/^"\d+"$/));

pm.test('Request excludes removed status and GPA criteria', () => { ['status','minimumGpa','maximumGpa','requiredGpa','gpaRange','gpaEligibility'].forEach(k => pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property(k)); });

pm.test('Company filter returns created Request', () => pm.expect(body.items.some(x => x.requestId === pm.collectionVariables.get('requestId') && x.company.companyId === pm.collectionVariables.get('companyId'))).to.be.true);

pm.test('Request detail returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Detail ID matches',()=>pm.expect(b.requestId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('requestId'))); pm.test('ETag matches version',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('ETag')).to.eql(`"${b.version}"`));
pm.test('Request fields updated', () => { pm.expect(body.title).to.eql(`Patch 9 Updated Intern ${pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')}`); pm.expect(body.shortlistGuidanceValue).to.eql(25); });

pm.test('Required Skill list returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Initial Skill exists',()=>pm.expect(b.items.map(x=>x.skillId)).to.include(pm.environment.get('activeSkillId')));

pm.test('Add Skill returns 201',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201)); const b=pm.response.json(); const e=pm.response.headers.get('ETag'); pm.test('Added Skill matches',()=>pm.expect(b.skillId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('secondActiveSkillId'))); pm.test('Parent ETag advanced',()=>pm.expect(e).to.match(/^"\d+"$/)); pm.collectionVariables.set('requiredSkillId2',b.requiredSkillId); pm.collectionVariables.set('requestEtag',e);

pm.test('Request refresh returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('requestEtag',pm.response.headers.get('ETag')); pm.test('Second Skill removed',()=>pm.expect(b.requiredSkills.map(x=>x.skillId)).to.not.include(pm.environment.get('secondActiveSkillId')));

pm.test('Atomic replacement returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const b=pm.response.json(); const ids=b.requiredSkills.map(x=>x.skillId); pm.test('Replacement is exact',()=>{pm.expect(ids).to.have.members([pm.environment.get('activeSkillId'),pm.environment.get('secondActiveSkillId')]); pm.expect(ids).to.have.length(2);}); pm.collectionVariables.set('requestEtag',pm.response.headers.get('ETag'));

item.name: 02 Reject Invalid Skill and Roll Back Patch

exec: pm.test('Request remains unchanged after invalid atomic patch',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: 06 Reject Removed Status and GPA Fields

exec: pm.test('Post-cascade Company create returns 201',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201)); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('cleanupCompanyId',b.companyId); pm.collectionVariables.set('cleanupCompanyEtag',pm.response.headers.get('ETag'));

pm.test('Canonical Skill remains usable after cascade',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201)); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Reused canonical Skill is present',()=>pm.expect(b.requiredSkills.map(x=>x.skillId)).to.include(pm.environment.get('activeSkillId'))); pm.collectionVariables.set('cleanupRequestId',b.requestId); pm.collectionVariables.set('cleanupRequestEtag',pm.response.headers.get('ETag'));
